name: GCP — Security Command Center Notification Disabled
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = google_cloud_logging_raw
| filter xdm.event.operation_sub_type contains "SecurityCenter" and (xdm.event.operation_sub_type contains "Delete" or xdm.event.operation_sub_type contains "Update")
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count() as scc_changes,
       values(xdm.source.user.username) as users,
       values(xdm.event.type) as operations,
       values(xdm.event.description) as events_seen
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, users, events_seen
description: google.cloud.securitycenter Delete* or Update* method — SCC notification routing disabled to suppress findings.
alert_name: GCP — Security Command Center Notification Disabled

TA0005 - Defense Evasion: T1562.001 - Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools
